title: 有馬記念の後に・筋肉の奇跡

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Incredible! With an explosive sprint, Mejiro Ryan snatches the win from star racer Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff… Wh-what… just happened…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: O-oh, yeah! Thank you! But…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I can barely remember what happened… I was scared, so I started running like crazy. That's all I know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I guess my body just kept on moving.
choice_data_list: This is a victory for your muscles, I'd say.
This is a victory for your muscles, I'd say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You're right… Even if I lost my senses, my body still remembered how to move.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I can't believe that I beat Oguri. But still, I'm happy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: O-Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I underestimated you. Never thought you'd make it so far this year.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Turns out I was wrong. You were impressive out there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's do it again. Next year I'll come back more prepared.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap bids Mejiro Ryan farewell and walks away with a flourish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: She's so cool… Now that's a real star Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You don't have a race at the end of next year yet, right? You're free?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I-I'll be free. Uh, you didn't have to come all the way back to ask or anything…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: This battle against a superstar was great experience for next year!
choice_data_list: What are you going to do next?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Next up is… the G1 at the beginning of the year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I wanna enter the spring Tenno Sho! I'll use this experience in a race against McQueen, so please help me prepare for it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After her surprise victory against Oguri Cap, Mejiro Ryan sets her sights on her next goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho—her rematch with Mejiro McQueen will surely be a battle to remember.
